description.zh:
1405 年至 1433 年，明朝郑和率船队七次远航，经东南亚、印度洋到达波斯湾与非洲东岸。

> 事件依据《明史·郑和传》《瀛涯胜览》《星槎胜览》《郑和航海图》等整理，具体日份为研究推定；航线为示意简化。疆域面来自 Seshat Cliopatria（CC BY 4.0）；满剌加、古里、忽鲁谟斯等小国与古吉拉特为示意补绘，所有边界均为学术估算，非精确国界。
description.en:
From 1405 to 1433, Zheng He led the Ming treasure fleet on seven voyages across Southeast Asia and the Indian Ocean to the Persian Gulf and the east coast of Africa.

> Events are compiled from the History of Ming, Yingya Shenglan, Xingcha Shenglan, the Zheng He Nautical Chart and related sources; exact days are scholarly estimates and the routes are simplified. Territory polygons come from Seshat Cliopatria (CC BY 4.0); Malacca, Calicut, Hormuz and other small polities, as well as Gujarat, are schematic additions. All boundaries are scholarly estimates, not precise state borders.

description.zh: 1405—1407：自太仓经长乐、占城、满剌加、旧港、爪哇、苏门答剌、锡兰山至古里，返航太仓。
description.en: 1405–1407: from Taicang via Changle, Champa, Malacca, Palembang, Java, Samudera and Ceylon to Calicut, then back to Taicang.

description.zh: 1408—1409：自太仓经长乐、占城、暹罗、满剌加、苏门答剌至锡兰山，再抵柯枝、古里，返航太仓。
description.en: 1408–1409: from Taicang via Changle, Champa, Siam, Malacca and Samudera to Ceylon, then to Cochin and Calicut, back to Taicang.

description.zh: 1410—1411：自太仓经长乐、占城、满剌加、苏门答剌、锡兰山至古里；回程再至锡兰山，擒亚烈苦奈儿，返航太仓。
description.en: 1410–1411: from Taicang via Changle, Champa, Malacca, Samudera and Ceylon to Calicut; on the return it called at Ceylon again, captured Alakeshvara, and sailed back to Taicang.

description.zh: 1413—1415：自太仓经长乐、占城、满剌加、苏门答剌、锡兰山、溜山、古里、忽鲁谟斯，抵阿丹与东非诸港，返航太仓。
description.en: 1413–1415: from Taicang via Changle, Champa, Malacca, Samudera, Ceylon, the Maldives, Calicut and Hormuz to Aden and the East African ports, then back to Taicang.

description.zh: 1417—1419：自太仓经长乐、占城、满剌加、锡兰山、柯枝、古里、忽鲁谟斯、阿丹至东非麻林地，返航太仓。
description.en: 1417–1419: from Taicang via Changle, Champa, Malacca, Ceylon, Cochin, Calicut, Hormuz and Aden to Malindi in East Africa, then back to Taicang.

description.zh: 1421—1422：送十六国使臣还国，自太仓经占城、满剌加、苏门答剌；分䑸访问榜葛剌，主队西至忽鲁谟斯、阿丹与东非，返航太仓。
description.en: 1421–1422: carrying envoys of sixteen states home, from Taicang via Champa, Malacca and Samudera; a squadron visited Bengal while the main fleet went west to Hormuz, Aden and East Africa, then back to Taicang.

description.zh: 1431—1433：自太仓经长乐、占城、旧港、爪哇、满剌加、苏门答剌、锡兰山、古里至忽鲁谟斯、阿丹；分䑸赴天方，东至东非，郑和卒于古里，船队返航太仓。
description.en: 1431–1433: from Taicang via Changle, Champa, Palembang, Java, Malacca, Samudera, Ceylon and Calicut to Hormuz and Aden; a detachment went on to Mecca and the fleet reached East Africa. Zheng He died at Calicut and the fleet returned to Taicang.

description.zh: 明朝东南沿海的海防体系示意线：北起辽东，经山东、南直隶、浙江、福建、广东，南至海南，并东连澎湖、台湾。海防线为示意，不表示行政疆域。
description.en: Schematic line of the Ming south-eastern coastal defence system, from Liaodong through Shandong, South Zhili, Zhejiang, Fujian and Guangdong to Hainan, with an eastern extension to Penghu and Taiwan. Schematic, not an administrative boundary.

description.zh: 满剌加、古里、忽鲁谟斯等港口与邦国。
description.en: Ports and states such as Malacca, Calicut, and Hormuz.

description.zh: 郑和船队的母国，1368—1644 年的明朝。
description.en: The Ming dynasty, 1368–1644, homeland of Zheng He’s fleet.

description.zh: 今越南中部的占城国，船队南下后的第一个重要停靠地。
description.en: Champa in central Vietnam, the fleet’s first major stop after sailing south.

description.zh: 今柬埔寨一带的吴哥王朝。
description.en: The Khmer Empire centred on Angkor in present-day Cambodia.

description.zh: 阿瑜陀耶王朝统治下的暹罗。
description.en: Siam under the Ayutthaya Kingdom.

description.zh: 以爪哇为中心的满者伯夷帝国。
description.en: The Majapahit Empire centred on Java.

description.zh: 苏门答腊岛北部的须文答剌—巴赛苏丹国。
description.en: The Samudera Pasai Sultanate in northern Sumatra.

description.zh: 僧伽罗政权统治下的锡兰岛。
description.en: Ceylon under Sinhalese rule.

description.zh: 南印度德干高原南部的毗奢耶那伽罗帝国。
description.en: The Vijayanagara Empire in southern India.

description.zh: 德干高原中部的巴赫曼尼苏丹国。
description.en: The Bahmani Sultanate in the central Deccan.

description.zh: 孟加拉湾北岸的孟加拉苏丹国，分䑸曾到此访问。
description.en: The Bengal Sultanate on the northern Bay of Bengal, visited by the detached squadron.

description.zh: 印度西北部的古吉拉特苏丹国，甘巴里与阿拨把丹在其境内。
description.en: The Gujarat Sultanate in north-western India, containing Cambay and Ahmadabad.

description.zh: 统治也门与亚丁的拉苏里王朝。
description.en: The Rasulid dynasty of Yemen and Aden.

description.zh: 统治埃及、叙利亚与汉志的马穆鲁克苏丹国，天方在其境内。
description.en: The Mamluk Sultanate of Egypt, Syria and the Hejaz, containing Mecca.

description.zh: 明朝东南海防范围，未设府县。此实体只用于表示台湾本岛的示意标注，不表示明朝行政疆域。
description.en: Within the Ming south-eastern coastal-defence sphere, without Ming prefectures or counties. This entity is an annotation for Taiwan, not an administrative territory.

notes.zh: 东番（台湾）：明朝东南海防范围，未设府县。
notes.en: Dongfan (Taiwan): within the Ming south-eastern coastal-defence sphere, without Ming prefectures or counties.

notes.zh: 沿海红色点线为明朝海防示意线，不是航线。
notes.en: The red dotted line along the coast is a schematic Ming coastal-defence line, not a voyage route.

notes.zh: 航行航线为虚线；点线为与主队并行的分䑸（第一、七次的爪哇·旧港支队，第七次的天方支队）。
notes.en: Voyage routes are dashed; dotted lines are detachments sailing alongside the main fleet (the Java–Palembang squadron in the 1st and 7th voyages, the Mecca squadron in the 7th).

notes.zh: 船队与人物：宝船六十二艘、将士二万七千八百余人（《明史·郑和传》）。郑和本姓马，云南昆阳人，1371 年生，1381 年入宫，靖难之役立功后赐姓郑。随行的马欢、费信、巩珍各著行纪，是下西洋最直接的一手记载。
notes.en: Fleet and people: 62 treasure ships and 27,800 men (History of Ming). Zheng He, born Ma He in Kunyang, Yunnan, in 1371, was taken into the palace in 1381 and granted the surname Zheng after service in the Jingnan campaign. Ma Huan, Fei Xin and Gong Zhen, who sailed with him, each left an account that remains the most direct primary record of the voyages.

notes.zh: 考古与争议：长乐《天妃灵应之记》碑（1431）现存福建长乐；布施锡兰山佛寺碑 1911 年发现于斯里兰卡，现存科伦坡国家博物馆；南京宝船厂遗址、湖北钟祥梁庄王墓（2001 年发掘）出土遗物可与文献互证。宝船尺度与船队最远处，学界仍有争议。
notes.en: Archaeology and debate: the Changle Tianfei stele (1431) survives in Fujian; the Ceylon trilingual inscription was found in Sri Lanka in 1911 and is held in Colombo; the Nanjing treasure-ship yard and the Liangzhuang princes’ tomb in Zhongxiang (excavated 2001) provide material corroboration. The dimensions of the treasure ships and the furthest point reached remain disputed.

notes.zh: 结局：宣德八年（1433）船队归国后，下西洋未再举行。《殊域周咨录》记「宣德中复开，至正统初复禁」。成化年间宪宗欲再下西洋、索求郑和出使水程，兵部车驾郎中刘大夏藏匿旧案，事遂寝。
notes.en: Aftermath: no further voyage was sent after the fleet returned in 1433; the Shuyu Zhouzi Lu notes that the voyages were reopened under Xuande and banned again in the early Zhengtong reign. In the Chenghua reign, when the emperor sought Zheng He’s sailing records, the ministry official Liu Daxia hid the files and the plan lapsed.
